05123a3ef5d9c940aacb2a69e98ed5fce1791439.summary: Cisco Umbrella blog post, published 2016-10-10, on why domain generation algorithms (DGAs) are effective for threat hunting. It uses a Necurs DGA session to surface related malicious domains tied to Facebook-linked campaigns that reportedly installed a malicious browser extension. It also notes a spike of JS-hosting domains under one top-level domain and a registrant account whose domains were blocked. No threat actor is named.

05d460230449630e5d22e7edcd53265a4b421c45.summary: Blog post by cocomelonc, published 2026-06-23, describing macOS persistence through Folder Actions: an AppleScript attached to a folder runs a harmless C program when files are added. It is presented as a safe lab proof of concept that writes a log file, with notes on GUI and command-line registration, cleanup, and blue-team detection hints. No threat actor, campaign, sector, country or CVE is named.
